title: Home renovation
description: A renovation team for a home project: a planner (scope, order of works, timeline), an estimator (budget and material quantities with stated assumptions), an interior designer (style, layout, colours from your photos) and a materials advisor. Keep your brief, measurements and budget in the library; drop photos into tasks.
audience: Someone planning a repair or renovation of an apartment or house.

resources.title: Renovation brief
resources.description: The project in one page: rooms, what to change, style, budget ceiling, deadline, constraints. All renovation agents read it first. FILL IT IN.

resources.title: Measurements
resources.description: Room dimensions, ceiling heights, window and door sizes, positions of utilities. Estimates and layouts rely on these numbers — add rooms as you measure.

resources.title: Budget and spending
resources.description: Total budget, what is already spent or ordered, reserve. The estimator keeps within it; update after purchases.

schedules.name: Renovation — weekly check-in
schedules.text: Weekly renovation check-in: read the brief, measurements and budget, look at the latest task results, and tell me in a short list what should happen this week, what decisions I owe, and what could slip. Ask about anything missing.

after: 1) Open 📚 Resources and fill in "Renovation brief", "Measurements" and "Budget and spending". 2) Upload photos of the rooms there too (give each a one-line description: which room, which wall, which side). 3) Start with a task for renovation-planner: "Make a plan and rough order of works for the project in the brief". Photos of one specific thing (a wall, a bathroom) are best attached to the task itself.
